summary: Grouse Peak lookout near Challis: a 1930s L-4 cab (one source says camp), abandoned and gone. A 2017 communication site nearby is not confirmed as the lookout's site.

facts.design: L-4 cab, 1930s (firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts); Forest Lookouts gives a camp (Kresek)
facts.status_note: Abandoned and described as gone; no source gives a removal date.

events.note: Forest Service decision signed 08/28/2017 acknowledging a change in ownership of a communication facility at Grouse Peak South; the notice does not mention the lookout

notes_for_editor: Thin sources. Two sites say L-4 cab (1930s); Forest Lookouts says camp (Kresek). No removal date. The FFLA Facebook post (search snippet only; the page could not be read in the cache) says built 1935 and taken down; it is not used because no quotable text was cached. The 2017 communication site Grouse Peak South is 8 miles ENE of Challis; the lookout is 8 miles northeast, and the two may be on the same summit, but no source confirms it, so the event is marked other and is not used as a status for the lookout. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives no staffing history, so staffing is left out. Access and the present state of the summit are not described by any page read. Record coordinates (44.56532, -114.09483) match the FFLA point and are close to a third-party peak listing; not checked against a source that gives coordinates. No new photos.
